title: The delivery-fee text — question explanation
learningObjective: Identify fraudulent SMS requests and verify through independent channels
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: You receive an SMS claiming a parcel is held for a small delivery fee. It includes a shortened link and says the parcel will be returned today.
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Identify fraudulent SMS requests and verify through independent channels
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option D: Use the courier’s official app or independently located website to check tracking; do not use the SMS link. Verify parcel status independently rather than following an unsolicited link.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option A: Providing personal information to an unverified sender creates additional exposure. Option B: A small payment request can be a pretext to harvest card details or credentials. Option C: Forwarding spreads the lure and does not verify its authenticity.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: Open the courier app or enter its known address yourself. Report and delete the suspicious message according to local procedures. Unexpected delivery texts with short links and urgent fees should be checked independently.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: Unexpected delivery texts with short links and urgent fees should be checked independently.
